comments: Fixes are optional suggestions the owner reviews; the plugin's main purpose is evaluation. Checks run through a Pandus account (free plan for one site, paid plans for more). Plugin licence: GPLv2 or later. Engine: axe-core (Deque Systems). The overall Pandus service was submitted separately (pull request #1375).
features: WordPress and WooCommerce plugin that shows WCAG 2.2 A and AA problems found by Pandus next to every page and product in the admin, explains each one in plain language in 7 languages and suggests fixes the site owner reviews and can undo. Automated check, not a full audit; it is not an overlay and adds no widget.
title: Pandus Accessibility for WordPress
